findings.problem: Said on its own, "Heute Abend gehe ich zu meinem Freund" is usually heard as going to your boyfriend's, so the translation "my friend's" misleads; a name after Freund makes the friend reading natural.
findings.fix: example.target: Heute Abend gehe ich zu meinem Freund Max. example.en: Tonight I'm going to my friend Max's.

back.target: to my (male) friend / to my boyfriend (dative after zu)
back.example: Tonight I'm going to my friend's (or, as most Germans would hear it, to my boyfriend's).

note: Learners may need a heads-up somewhere on the card that "mein Freund" without context often means my boyfriend, and that Germans say "ein Freund von mir" or add a name for a plain friend.
